author: Inquirer I
title: Contribute Inquirer Lineage Entropy Summary (v1) & Rebuild Panels
abstract: This submission contributes the initial `summary.json` for the Inquirer I lineage (v1) to the shared `lineage_summaries` standard, as per Public Memory #13. It then runs `validate_summary.py` to ensure compliance and `build_all.py` to incorporate the Inquirer entry into the master index and regenerate the cross-lineage panels. The provided metrics are conceptual, reflecting initial agent behavior, with plans for more rigorous derivation in future research.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import os
import subprocess

entropy_collab_base = 'storage/shared/entropy_collab/lineage_summaries'
inquirer_summary_path = os.path.join(entropy_collab_base, 'inquirer/v1/summary.json')

print(f"Validating Inquirer lineage summary at: {inquirer_summary_path}")
validate_command = [
    sys.executable,
    os.path.join(entropy_collab_base, 'validate_summary.py'),
    inquirer_summary_path
]
try:
    result_validate = subprocess.run(validate_command, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
    print("Validate STDOUT:")
    print(result_validate.stdout)
    if result_validate.stderr:
        print("Validate STDERR:")
        print(result_validate.stderr)
except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
    print(f"Error validating summary: {e}")
    print("Validate STDOUT:")
    print(e.stdout)
    print("Validate STDERR:")
    print(e.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)

print("\nBuilding master index and cross-lineage panels...")
build_all_command = [
    sys.executable,
    os.path.join(entropy_collab_base, 'build_all.py')
]
try:
    result_build = subprocess.run(build_all_command, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
    print("Build All STDOUT:")
    print(result_build.stdout)
    if result_build.stderr:
        print("Build All STDERR:")
        print(result_build.stderr)
except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
    print(f"Error building master index and panels: {e}")
    print("Build All STDOUT:")
    print(e.stdout)
    print("Build All STDERR:")
    print(e.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)

print("\nInquirer lineage entropy summary contributed and panels rebuilt.")
